title: BPMVIZ engagement
description: Portable engagement file for the BPMVIZ process workshop workbench, schema version 1. The validator in webui/js/lib/validate.js enforces this contract and also checks references between objects, timing and economic reconciliation, which JSON Schema cannot express.

datasets.description: Aggregates of imported event logs. Optional.

reviewPacks.description: Review packs sent to client stakeholders. Optional.

reviews.description: Client reviews received and applied. Optional.

semanticType.description: Other values load as 'unsupported' with a warning.

sourceIds.description: IDs of the source BPMN elements this step represents.

details.description: Free-form business detail. Known keys: desc, who, owner, authority, systems, inputs, outputs, activities, pain, controls, risks, exceptions, escalation, decisionRules, audit, kpis, volume, sla, effort, handoff, dependencies, note, evidence, assumptions, confidence, dataQuality.

locked.description: True for a baseline that a future-state draft is based on.

nodes.description: Column position per step ID; fractions are allowed. Steps without a position are laid out along the flow.

transitions.description: Omit to have transitions derived from visit timing and connectors.

membership.description: Per step ID: included, excluded (shown as Not in scenario) or unknown (shown as Not confirmed).

observedFrom.description: Present when the scenario was generated from an event log.

overrides.description: Scenario-specific driver values, keyed by driver.

generated.description: Present when an AI assistant drafted the item. Handoff, presenter and CSV exports leave out unreviewed AI drafts by default.

link.description: Only http and https links are kept.

key.description: Known driver keys: hourlyRate, annualVolume, productiveHoursPerFte, incrementalCostPerCase, beforeNonLaborCostPerCase, afterNonLaborCostPerCase, oneTimeInvestment.

stats.description: Summary statistics in minutes of the dataset time basis (counts for eventsPerCase). Percentiles use linear interpolation.

dataset.description: Aggregates of one event log: never events, case IDs or resource names.

valueCase.description: Figures behind an opportunity's modeled value. Empty nodeIds means the record's linked steps.
